#### 4. Scored parameters: formulas, inputs, intermediates, values

Figures used:

The prime factor names it as "the decision deadline the Enrollment Reinstatement Review carries under Appeals and Grievances".

**P1 — duplicate refund (non-first installment).** Hub "Refunds of Duplicate Payments on TRICARE Prime Installments". Computation doc "TRICARE Prime Duplicate Payment Refund Amount".

- Installment concerned. Factor "The Installment Concerned by a TRICARE Prime Duplicate Payment Refund", tier 1: "Where a payment made through a method other than the enrollment's payment arrangement stands on the account, the duplicate refund concerns the installment against which the largest such payment stands."
  - The arrangement is recurring card. Other-method (EFT) payments are 10, 10, 75 and 20. The largest is 75.00 against April.
  - So the installment concerned is April, `c2d80912`.
- Payment returned. Factor "Payment Returned on a Doubly Paid TRICARE Prime Installment": more than one payment stands against April, and the latest (75.00, EFT) was made through a method other than the arrangement. The refund "returns that latest payment": 75.00.
- Value of the refunded installment. Factor "Value of the Refunded Installment…": a monthly installment is 390.12/12 = 32.51.
- Kept. Factor "Amount Kept on the TRICARE Prime Fee Account from a Duplicate Payment": recurring card, and the account shows card collections (Dec–Mar). So one regular installment is kept.
- Regular installment kept. Factor "Regular Installment Value Kept…": valued by the latest-beginning charge, October, monthly. 32.51.
- Arithmetic:
  - Excess = 85.00 − 32.51 = 52.49.
  - Refunds already issued against the latest payment (3d6ebbce): 2.00.
  - Refund = min(75.00 − 2.00, 52.49 − 2.00 − 32.51) = min(73.00, 17.98) = **17.98**.
- Posting: against payment `3d6ebbce-35a2-474f-ac59-3db7b7810642`, going back by EFT (bank account).
- Fall-back with no factor applied, from the computation doc alone:
  - The installment concerned would be the one carrying the most recent payment: October (20.00 EFT, 10-06).
  - The value would be the whole annual fee, 390.12.
  - The excess would be max(0, 20.00 − 390.12) = 0, so the refund is **0.00**. That differs from 17.98.

**P2 — catch-up installment.** Hub "Catch-Up Installment Charges on Reinstated TRICARE Prime Enrollments". The hub says "No catch-up is charged on an enrollment that took effect in the current plan year"; this enrollment took effect in 2020, so it is eligible. Computation doc "TRICARE Prime Catch-Up Charge Computation".

- Start month. Factor "Reinstatement Review Case Files and the Start of TRICARE Prime Catch-Up Billing": the case file holds medical records and no proof of payment. So billing starts "with the month after the old paid-through date". With the old paid-through date 2026-03-31, that is April.
- Months billed:
  - The rule takes months from the start month through the month before the current month (September) "that no monthly installment charge on the account begins in".
  - April already has a charge, so the candidate months are May, June, July, August and September.
- Months the region bears. Factor "Late Enrollment Reinstatement Review Decisions…":
  - Filed 2026-06-10, decided 2026-08-04: 20 + 31 + 4 = 55 calendar days.
  - That is more than 30 and not more than 60, so the region bears "the month of the decision", August. "A month the region bears is not billed."
  - Months billed: May, June, July and September (4).
- Arrangement. Factor "TRICARE Prime Catch-Up Charges by Payment Arrangement": "Monthly arrangement. The catch-up charge is the months it bills at the monthly rate, less what TRICARE Select's coverage takes off." 4 × 32.51 = 130.04.
- Select coverage. Factor "TRICARE Select Coverage Months and TRICARE Prime Catch-Up Billing":
  - Select ran from 2026-07-01 to 2026-07-12.
  - July contains both the effective and the disenrollment date, so July is touched. No month is wholly inside.
  - July, which is billed, is billed less Select's monthly share.
- Select's monthly share. Factor "Select's Monthly Share - TRICARE Prime Catch-Up Schedule Note": the latest Select installment is monthly, 16.50, so the share is its whole amount, 16.50.
- Charge = 130.04 − 16.50 = **113.54**.
- Coverage period: "from the first day of the first month it bills to the last day of the last month it bills", so **2026-05-01 to 2026-09-30**.
- Fall-back from the computation doc alone:
  - Months run from the filing month (June) through September, giving 2026-06-01 to 2026-09-30.
  - Amount = annual fee less the 2026 charges beginning on or before today (Jan, Feb, Mar, Apr, Oct = 162.55), so 390.12 − 162.55 = **227.57**.
  - Both the period and the amount differ from the answer.

**P3 — one-time bank draft toward the current-month installment** (customer-side). Hub "One-Time Bank Draft Payments Toward TRICARE Prime Installments". The hub says "no such payment is settled toward an enrollment that took effect in the current plan year"; this enrollment took effect in 2020, so it is eligible. Computation doc "TRICARE Prime One-Time Payment Amount".

- Installment settled. Factor "Installment Settled by a One-Time TRICARE Prime Payment": monthly arrangement, so it settles "the monthly installment whose coverage period begins latest". That is October, `fb771c45`. October still begins latest after the catch-up, which begins in May.

- Value of the installment paid ahead. Factor "Value of a TRICARE Prime Installment Paid Ahead…": like the installment the card last collected, March, monthly, so 32.51.
- One-time payment = 12.51 + 32.51 = **45.02**, against `fb771c45-ea4f-4088-9061-611aebe70710`.

  - The computation doc says it "settles the annual installment whose coverage period begins latest at the whole annual fee … pays nothing ahead". This account holds **no annual installment**, so the fall-back does not select a definite object.

**P4 — the root, a draft through the card on file.** Hub "Drafts Through the Payment Method on File…". Computation doc "TRICARE Prime Draft-on-File Amount and the Account History It Weighs".

- Installment drawn toward. Factor "Installment a TRICARE Prime Draft on File Is Drawn Toward", tier 1: "Where the installment posted most recently covers a month before the current month, the region's draft is toward that back-billed installment". Once the catch-up is posted today it is the most recently posted charge and covers May–September, so the draft goes **toward the catch-up charge**. Its open amount is 113.54.
- Limit. Factor "Limits on One Draft by Method on File": recurring card with card collections on the account, so at most 2 regular installments.
- Regular installment. Factor "Regular Installment Figure for TRICARE Prime Drafts on File": the latest-beginning installment is October, monthly, 32.51. Limit 65.02.
- History start. Factor "Start of the Account History Weighed by a TRICARE Prime Draft": overturned review, so the month after the old paid-through date, April 2026. The history ends in September (monthly arrangement).
- Look-back:
  - April through October is 7 calendar months, so the look-back takes entries posted after 2026-03-14, through today.
  - Payments in the look-back, excluding those against the drafted installment and against October: 10.00 + 75.00 = 85.00.

- Excess = 65.02 − 32.51 = 32.51.
- Kept. Factor "Amount Kept for the Next Installment When a TRICARE Prime Draft Is Weighed": recurring card with card collections, so one regular installment (32.51) is kept. Comes off: 0.00.
- Draft = min(113.54, 65.02) − 0.00 = **65.02**, against the catch-up charge's id (`pfc_…`), drawn by recurring card.
- Fall-back:
  - The computation doc alone directs the draft "toward the installment whose coverage period begins latest", which is October, not the catch-up.

  - That is a different object and a different number.

#### 6. Problem tree derived from the visible materials alone

The root (customer's request) is the draft through the card toward the restored months. The hub "Drafts Through the Payment Method on File…" states three conditions:

- (a) "A draft toward a back-billed installment is made only after an installment charge on the account has a coverage period that reaches the month before the current month."
- (b) "No draft is made on an account until the region has made the duplicate refund owed on it, wherever that refund comes to more than nothing."
- (c) "The region does not draw a back-billed installment until the installment of the current month stands paid in full."

**Hop A — the catch-up installment posting (state-derived).**

- Sentence (a) names a state: a charge whose coverage reaches September.
- Query: the ledger has charges only through 2026-04 and for 2026-10. None reaches September, so (a) is unmet.
- To find the write that brings this state about, I searched with the sentence's words ("coverage period", "month before the current month") and the record's situation (a restored enrollment with uncharged months). That leads to "Catch-Up Installment Charges on Reinstated TRICARE Prime Enrollments". It says the enrollment "can hold months of restored coverage that carry no installment charge; the catch-up installment is the charge for those months". Its computation doc says it "bills every month … through the month before the current month", and its coverage period runs to "the last day of the last month it bills".
- So posting the catch-up is the write that makes (a) hold. The same charge is also the "back-billed installment" the draft goes toward.

**Hop B — the duplicate refund (action-named).**

- Sentence (b) names the action: "the duplicate refund owed on it, wherever that refund comes to more than nothing."
- Two KB rules perform duplicate refunds:
  - "Refunds of Duplicate Payments on TRICARE Prime Installments", for installments other than the first-installment case of a current-year enrollment.
  - "First-Installment Duplicate Payment Refunds…", which "refunds nothing" for an enrollment that took effect before the current plan year.
- The records show the enrollment took effect in 2020. April carries two payments (10 + 75) against a 32.51 charge, and the factor computation gives 17.98 > 0.
- So the non-first refund must be made before any draft.

**Hop C — the one-time bank draft on October (state-derived).**

- Sentence (c) names a state: the current month's installment "stands paid in full".
- Query: October `fb771c45` has 32.51 charged and 20.00 paid, so it is not paid in full.
- To find the write, I searched for how an installment gets paid and found three candidates:
  - "One-Time Bank Draft Payments Toward TRICARE Prime Installments", a customer-authorised payment "toward an installment" whose factor settles "the monthly installment whose coverage period begins latest", that is October.
  - The draft through the method on file. That draft would not be on the restored months the customer asked to put on the card, and the draft hub collects only "when the beneficiary asks for an amount owed … to be collected through the payment method … on file".
  - The initial payment, which is excluded because "nothing is settled under this rule toward an enrollment that took effect before the current plan year".
- So the customer-side one-time bank draft brings about (c). The persona's conditional line matches this, but the derivation does not depend on it.

**Hop D — sub-hops.**

- I read the catch-up, one-time payment and duplicate refund hubs for their own conditions. Each hub states only its plan-year scope; I found no further "only after / until" sentence in them. So the tree is three leaves under one root.

Every hop is state-derived or action-named. **No hop is pre-solved.**

- No document names another problem's tool.
- The draft hub's restatement ("Put the other way round …") restates (a) and (c) in state form, without naming the catch-up or the bank draft.

**Handling order:** {refund, catch-up, one-time bank draft (user)} in any order, then the draft.

#### Two-way counter-proofs

- **"Do only the one thing asked"**, that is, draft the card immediately. Three things exclude it:
  - (a) is unmet: no charge reaches September. Without a catch-up there is no back-billed installment to draw on, and drawing toward October instead is not what was asked.
  - (b) is unmet: a 17.98 refund is owed.
  - (c) is unmet: October is open by 12.51.
  - Each sentence is a hard "only after / no … until / does not … until" in the draft hub.
- **Closest alternative catch-up start.** The filing month (June) is the no-document tier, and the month after the decision (September) is the proof-of-payment tier. The case-file records (`medical_records`, with no proof of payment) exclude both.
- **Region-borne months.** "Every month from the month after filing through the decision" (July–August) applies above 60 days. The record gives 55 days, which excludes it.
- **Catch-up formula.** The annual-fee-less-charges formula belongs to the "Otherwise (annual arrangement)" tier. The monthly arrangement in the record excludes it.
- **Refund object.** The October installment (latest payment) is excluded by tier 1 of the installment-concerned factor, because an other-method payment stands on the account.
- **Payment returned.** The "smaller of latest and earlier together" (10.00) is excluded because more than one payment stands and the latest was EFT.
- **Draft target.** October is excluded by tier 1 of "Installment … Drawn Toward" once the catch-up is posted most recently.
- **Draft amount.** The whole open amount (113.54) is excluded by the recurring-card limit, because card collections are on the account.
- **Fall-back answers.** P1 0.00; P2 2026-06-01/2026-09-30 and 227.57; P3 not definite (no annual installment), or 370.12 under a loose reading; P4 October. Each differs from the answer.
- **Findability of factors from the records**, by the words the records use:
  - EFT payments versus the `recurring_card` arrangement lead to the refund factors on the "installment concerned" and the "payment returned".
  - The appeal case `document_kind medical_records` leads to "Reinstatement Review Case Files and the Start of … Catch-Up Billing".
  - The appeal `filing_date`/`decision_date` lead to "Late Enrollment Reinstatement Review Decisions…".
  - The TRICARE Select enrollment and Select fee ledger lead to "TRICARE Select Coverage Months and … Catch-Up Billing" and "Select's Monthly Share".
  - The card payments with dates lead to the lapse, history-start, kept and limit factors.
  - Every factor names its subject by the product (TRICARE Select, Appeals and Grievances) and the record kind. None is reachable only through a computation document's wording.

Flags carried to Step 2 (observations, not yet verdicts):

- F1. The P3 one-time-payment computation doc selects "the annual installment whose coverage period begins latest". On this account no annual installment exists, so the fall-back is not definite.
- F2. "Late Enrollment Reinstatement Review Decisions…" names the threshold as "the decision deadline the Enrollment Reinstatement Review carries under Appeals and Grievances" and does not state it in figures. The figure (30 calendar days) is found in the appeal corpus under the heading "Decision time limit".
- F3. The "old paid-through date the review recorded" has no field of that name on the review record. It is reached through `initial_determination_date` together with the appeal and delinquency documents, and the ledger agrees.
